paragraphs: (The sons of Chovav, Moses’ father-in-law, Exodus 4:11, as cited by Hyman. Compare [Judges 4:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Judges.4.11).) Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva: [Berakhot 41a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.42a.3).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The reference to Chovav’s descendants comes from Judges 4:11. [Numbers 10:29](https://www.sefaria.org/Numbers.10.29) names Chovav as the son of Reuel the Midianite and calls him Moses’ father-in-law. Hyman’s parenthetical locator is retained.

The Berakhot link opens 42a, where Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva’s household appears in the account of Rav Yehudah arranging his son’s marriage. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1692&lang=en) cites 42a for this account as well. Hyman’s text gives 41a.
